title: UCCE, Avaya, and moved history
blurb: WFM connectors are not an ACD cutover. Multi-ACD versions, legacy Avaya, and Migrated Calls stay on their own pages.

lessons.title: Two migrations get confused on purpose
lessons.summary: A WFM connector copies agent state and history. Multi-ACD records a phone system you keep. Migrated Calls uploads old recordings. None of those pages is a full ACD cutover cookbook.
objectives: Cite the page that matches the work

p: The Cisco UCCE connector and the Avaya CMS pages feed Workforce Management. Engagement Hub and the Multi-ACD table record or process a third-party phone system. Migrated Calls uploads historical recordings into CXone.
Moving agents onto CXone as their ACD is a different program. This lab will not invent the weekend cutover.

lessons.title: The UCCE connector is on premises and speaks SQL
lessons.summary: The connector page supports Cisco Unified CCE 11.6. Real-time adherence uses the Cisco connector. Historical skills use SQL every 15 minutes. Intraday is not supported. Outbound dialer, fax, SMS, and web are no.

p: The connector is on-premise software. It receives agent state from the Cisco ACD and relays it for real-time adherence. RTA is yes, reason codes are yes, and the method is the Cisco connector for the ACD node.

Historical skills are yes, by SQL queries on the Cisco ACD database, at a 15-minute interval. Historical adherence is pulled every 15 minutes. Intraday data is not supported. Inbound voice, email, and chat are yes. Outbound dialer, fax, SMS, and web are no.
The prerequisites say NiCE CXone supports Cisco Unified CCE version 11.6. That sentence belongs to this WFM connector.
The Multi-ACD table later names UCCE 12.6 and 15 for recording. Do not paste those versions onto this connector, or 11.6 onto Multi-ACD.

lessons.title: Web Setup must say AW-HDS-DDS
lessons.summary: After install, verify PG data and the Administration and Data Server role. The role is Administration Server, Real-time and Historical Data Server, and Detail Data Server.

p: The page says to verify the Administration and Data Server role is AW-HDS-DDS: Administration Server, Real-time and Historical Data Server, and Detail Data Server.
Also verify Logical Controller and Agent Distribution in PG Explorer. The screenshot names vary by customer. If you change them, save.
Create a role, remove all permissions, save and activate, then create an employee on that role and deselect attributes. Generate the access key as that employee. The secret is shown once.

The installer file on the page is acd-node-cisco-UCCE-installer-distribution. Java 1.8, outbound ports 443 and 80, and the permissions Access Key: Create and Can access support downloads are in the prerequisites.

lessons.title: Multi-ACD has its own Cisco and Avaya table
lessons.summary: UCCX 12.5 and 15 with NBR or BiB. UCCE 12.6 and 15. CUCM 12.5, 14, and 15, with a note that Cisco support for 12.5 ended 31 August 2025. Teams uses a recording bot and Graph library v1.2.0.
objectives: Keep the Teams bot on Azure

p: On the Multi-ACD page, UCCX 12.5 and 15 use the UCCX CTI server and NBR or BiB. UCCE 12.6 and 15 use the UCCE CTI server. The dialer column names each product's dialer.

CUCM for BiB and for NBR lists 12.5, 14, and 15, with JTAPI. The asterisk says Cisco support for CUCM 12.5 ended on 31 August 2025. SBC rows name CUBE, AudioCodes, Oracle, and Ribbon versions. Copy a row only while looking at the live table.

lessons.title: Avaya CMS and Avaya CMS Legacy are different connectors
lessons.summary: The current Avaya CMS page is an SDK over REST, inbound voice only, with intraday. The legacy ASC is version 19, on premises, SQL on Informix, and intraday is not supported.
objectives: Match the page to the installer
Mint a dedicated key on both

p: The Avaya CMS page connects through the SDK. Real-time and historical methods are REST APIs, at 15 minutes. Intraday is used in Intraday Manager. Data types: inbound voice yes. Outbound dialer, email, chat, fax, SMS, and web are no.

Create a specific user and do not assign permissions. The SDK sample sets the service URL, access key, and secret. Queue reports must include the agent queue report and the agent system performance report, or an empty JSON array.

Legacy ASC is on-premise software. The prerequisite is Avaya CMS ASC version 19. Historical skills use SQL on the Avaya ACD database every 15 minutes. Intraday is not supported. Chat is yes. Email is no. The database is IBM Informix.
The installer name is asc-avayacms-installer-distribution. The same dedicated-employee rule applies, because the key inherits permissions.

lessons.title: Migrated Calls is a license, a format, and a list of vendors
lessons.summary: You need the Migrated Interactions Upload license and the upload permission. Sources include Engage, CXone, Uptivity, and named third parties. Engage NMF plays back as MP4. Screen and digital do not migrate.

p: Migrated Calls needs the Migrated Interactions Upload license and Admin > Recording > Upload Migrated Interactions. Users import in three steps: export from both systems, merge, import. Every user needs an email. Teams are not synchronized; they are uploaded with Bulk Employee Upload. Only calls with a valid Admin user import.
Engage agents import as agents. A manager who was not an agent must be created manually. Engage 6.7 and higher, and 7.x, are the versions named.

Metadata is JSON or a ZIP of JSON. Required fields include call start and end, DNIS, ANI, direction, agent name or identifier, and a correlation value to the media file. Engage media stays NMF and converts to MP4 when someone plays or extracts it.

Search under the Migrated Interactions tab. External data is scanned by Guard Duty. Not supported: screen recordings, digital interactions, Engage evaluations and scores, QM or IA on migrated data, custom or Azure storage, CTIA events, and skills import. Completed-call playback is not currently supported, though segments and complete calls can be uploaded. Business data is up to 50 fields.

lessons.title: What a bridge design is allowed to say
lessons.summary: You can say how data is recorded or fed to WFM. You cannot say the ACD moved unless a page you cite says that. Account representatives and Professional Services own the gaps.

p: A defensible bridge says which connector, which version page, which key employee, and which recording row. It says phone DNIS is configured by Professional Services before a phone point of contact, and toll-free ownership follows the RespOrg rules.
Engagement Hub names Supervisor, Copilot for Supervisors, QM, and WFM as consumers of third-party data.
Do not publish a minute-by-minute UCCE or Avaya cutover. Do not claim IEX steps and CXone WFM steps are the same. Do not claim a CUCM version that is not in the row you read.
If the live table has changed since this lab was written, the live table wins. That is why versions are quoted with their page.
